How selection works

Cockpit adds control without replacing Hermes' safety model.

  • Use Model catalog to mark which models the router may choose.
  • The Semantic Router auxiliary slot is the dedicated decision model and never routes itself.
  • Choose Semantic Auto in Assignments for the main conversation, subagents, or individual auxiliary jobs.
  • A decision is validated against your allow-list before Hermes uses it.
  • Timeouts, invalid answers, and unavailable models keep the configured native fallback.
  • No prompt text or credentials are stored in routing history.
